verdicts.reason: A keeps logo, eyebrow, headline and CTA on one clean left edge, but everything is crammed against the canvas edges: the logo nearly touches the top and the button nearly touches the bottom. The legal line is illegibly tiny and jammed beside the button, and the product bag runs down to the bottom edge. B has the same cramped steps and tiny legal text, and its left column is also misaligned: the logo is centred, the text is left-aligned at about 18 px and the button is indented to about 38 px, so the three elements share no common edge and look arbitrary.
